title: Head and flow: how much power is in your stream?
description: An original animated explainer. Hydro power comes from two numbers, head and flow. P = rho x g x Q x H x efficiency, a worked example for a small UK hill stream (5 L/s and 10 m head gives about 245 W), how to measure flow with a bucket and head with a water-filled hose, and a rule of thumb you can do in your head.
